units.X-peptide10: A decapeptide of a protein searched under its genetic code finds the coding DNA's contexts.
units.X-peptide-long: A 20- or 30-residue peptide with supported paths: a path of its taxid, record verified.
units.X-table1: A decapeptide of another code read in table 1: the record's codons are out of reach (an expected miss).
units.X-stop-found: A protein's last 9 residues and its stop: found at the stop codon under the protein's table.
units.X-stop-none: A stop in a table without stop codons (27, 28, 31): exact 0 without a search.
units.X-junction: A window across an exon junction: no path spells the spliced DNA.
units.X-edge-ambiguity: The ambiguity codes B, Z, J and X stand for their residues: the peptide is still found.
units.X-edge-other: An unknown genetic code is refused; 11 residues without long_search answer anchors only; U is a bad_alphabet slot beside an answered pattern.
